raw.details:
HackPulse 2026 — Hack the Pulse. Shape the Future.

Build. Innovate. Compete.

HackPulse 2026 is a 12-hour offline hackathon organized by the University of Engineering and Management (UEM), Jaipur, bringing together students, developers, designers, AI enthusiasts, innovators, and problem solvers to turn ideas into working technology solutions.

HackPulse is built for people who don't just want to talk about ideas — they want to build them.

Whether you're participating solo or with a team, you will get the opportunity to identify real-world problems, experiment with emerging technologies, build a functional solution, and present your work before a judging panel.

From AI agents and automation to innovative software solutions, HackPulse gives participants the freedom to explore, experiment, and create.

Tracks

1. Open Innovation

Build a solution to a real-world problem of your choice.

Identify a meaningful problem and develop a technology-driven solution that addresses it.

You have the freedom to choose your own domain, problem statement, technology stack, and approach.

The problem is yours. The solution is yours. Build something that matters.

2. Agentic Harness

Build with AI agents. Go beyond simple chatbots.

This track focuses on AI agents, intelligent automation, tool-calling, workflows, autonomous decision-making, and agentic systems.

Participants can build solutions involving:

The objective is to demonstrate how intelligent systems can reason, act, use tools, and solve meaningful problems.

Prizes & Rewards

₹30,000 Cash Prize Pool

HackPulse 2026 offers a total cash prize pool of ₹30,000 for the top-performing teams.

The detailed distribution of the cash prizes will be communicated through the official event announcements.

₹15 Lakhs+ Worth of In-Kind Rewards & Partner Benefits

And that's not all.

HackPulse 2026 is being supported by technology, education, community, and industry partners who may provide in-kind rewards, resources, credits, subscriptions, learning opportunities, goodies, and other benefits.

The overall partner-supported in-kind value is ₹15 Lakhs+.

Potential partner benefits may include:

️ Cloud & Infrastructure Credits

Access to cloud platforms, hosting resources, infrastructure credits, and developer services where provided by participating partners.

AI & Developer Tools

Access to AI platforms, APIs, developer tools, automation platforms, productivity tools, and other technology resources.

Software & Premium Resources

Potential access to premium software, platforms, subscriptions, domains, development resources, and technology products.

Learning & Certification Opportunities

Learning resources, courses, workshops, certifications, educational benefits, and skill-development opportunities from participating partners.

Goodies & Swags

Exclusive HackPulse and partner merchandise, goodies, stickers, T-shirts, accessories, and other participant rewards, subject to availability.

Mentorship & Industry Interaction

Opportunities to interact with mentors, developers, industry professionals, and technology communities.

Career & Opportunity Exposure

Subject to partner offerings and eligibility, selected participants may receive access to internship, hiring, community, incubation, or other career-related opportunities.

Community & Networking

Connect with fellow developers, builders, students, founders, mentors, judges, and technology communities.

Note: In-kind rewards and partner benefits are subject to partner availability, eligibility requirements, applicable terms, and final confirmation from respective partners. The ₹15 Lakhs+ figure represents the potential aggregate value of partner-supported benefits and is not a cash component of the prize pool.

Team Size

  • Minimum: 1 participant
  • Maximum: 4 participants
  • Solo participation is allowed
  • Participants can form teams of up to 4 members.
  • Teams may consist of participants with different technical and non-technical skills.

A team could include developers, designers, AI enthusiasts, product thinkers, researchers, or anyone who can contribute to building and presenting the solution.

Registration Fee

FREE — ₹0 Registration Fee

There is no registration fee for HackPulse 2026.

Eligibility

Everyone can apply.

HackPulse welcomes:

  • College students
  • Developers
  • Designers
  • AI enthusiasts
  • Startup enthusiasts
  • Hackathon builders
  • Problem solvers
  • Innovators
  • Technology enthusiasts

There are no specific academic or technical restrictions for registration.

You don't need to be an expert. You need an idea and the willingness to build.

Hackathon Process

Round 1 — Registration

Register for HackPulse 2026 through Unstop.

Participants can register individually or form a team of up to four members.

Round 2 — Selection & Invitation

Registrations will be reviewed according to the event's selection process.

Selection will consider registration order and GitHub profile evaluation.

Only selected participants/teams will receive an official invitation to attend the offline hackathon.

Round 3 — Offline Hackathon

Selected participants will report to UEM Jaipur on 4 October 2026.

The 12-hour build sprint will begin at 9:00 AM.

Teams will work on their selected problem statement/idea and build their solution during the event.

Round 4 — Project Presentation & Evaluation

Teams will present their project before the judging panel.

Participants should be prepared to:

  • Explain the problem
  • Demonstrate their solution
  • Explain their technology stack
  • Demonstrate the working prototype
  • Explain their implementation
  • Answer questions from judges

Round 5 — Final Results

The final evaluation will determine the winning teams.

Winners will be announced at the conclusion of the hackathon.

‍️ Judging Criteria

Projects may be evaluated on:

  • Innovation & Originality
  • Problem Understanding
  • Technical Implementation
  • Use of Technology / AI
  • Impact & Usefulness
  • Feasibility
  • Scalability
  • UI/UX
  • Working Prototype
  • Final Demonstration
  • Presentation & Communication

The judging panel may consider the overall quality, completeness, technical depth, and demonstrated potential of the project.

What You Can Build

There is no fixed technology stack.

Participants are free to use technologies such as:

  • AI / ML
  • Generative AI
  • Agentic AI
  • Web Development
  • Mobile Development
  • Cloud
  • APIs
  • Automation
  • Blockchain
  • Data Science
  • IoT
  • Cybersecurity
  • Open-source technologies

Participants are encouraged to select technologies that best fit their problem and solution.

Final Submission

Teams will be required to submit/present their completed project within the specified event timeline.

Depending on the final submission instructions, teams may be required to provide:

  • Working project/prototype
  • PPT presentation
  • GitHub repository
  • Project description
  • Technology stack
  • Live demonstration
  • Other required submission details

Detailed submission instructions will be shared with selected participants.

Rules & Code of Conduct

All participants must follow the official HackPulse rules and Code of Conduct.

Official Documents

HackPulse Rules & Regulations:
[INSERT RULES LINK]

HackPulse Code of Conduct:
[ CODE OF CONDUCT ]

By registering for HackPulse 2026, participants acknowledge that they have read and agree to comply with the applicable rules, guidelines, and Code of Conduct.

Important Rules

  • Individual and team participation is allowed.
  • Maximum team size is 4 members.
  • Participation is free.
  • Core development must take place during the hackathon.
  • Pre-built projects are not allowed.
  • Plagiarism or copied projects may result in disqualification.
  • Open-source libraries and resources may be used subject to applicable licenses.
  • Participants must follow organizer instructions.
  • Teams must submit their project within the specified deadline.
  • Professional and respectful conduct is mandatory.
  • The decision of the judging panel will be final.

Offline Experience

HackPulse is an in-person build experience at UEM Jaipur.

Selected participants will have access to event facilities and participant support during the hackathon.

Participants can expect:

  • UEM Jaipur campus venue
  • Wi-Fi connectivity
  • Power access
  • Food during the event
  • ️ Accommodation arrangements for eligible selected participants
  • ‍ Mentorship / participant support where applicable
  • 12-hour build environment
  • Project presentations
  • Final judging and awards
  • Swags and partner benefits, subject to availability

Further details regarding accommodation, food, reporting, and event-day arrangements will be communicated to selected participants.

What Participants Should Bring

Selected participants should carry:

  • Laptop
  • Laptop charger
  • College ID
  • Government-issued ID
  • Registration confirmation
  • GitHub account/access
  • Any other equipment required for their project

Participants should ensure that their development environment and required software are ready before arriving at the venue.
